newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Corporate Express pounded.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Corporate Express pounded.

text.p: Corporate Express Inc's stock price was nearly halved preceding Wednesday's U.S. market open, the shares dumped after the company warned early this morning of fourth quarter results that will fail to meet Wall Street expectations.
In very active third market activity, Corporate Express shares fell to 10, with a small amount of trades at 10-1/8 and 10-1/16, from Tuesday's Nasdaq close of 18-5/16.
Wall Street had been expecting earnings of $0.16 per share for the fourth quarter and $0.50 for the year, according to First Call consensus estimates of the company.
